note: Triennial election of the county council, 1914: polled 28 May 1914 in four divisions; the other seventeen (nineteen seats) returned unopposed. Returned unopposed. Maynard Sinton: no party label printed in 1914. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Tandragee, 25 May 1905, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 2 June 1905, p. 5 ("Council Elections: 2 Unionist Gains, 1 Nationalist"); candidates in the Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1905, p. 5 ("Nominations: County Councillors"); Markethill Area, 5 June 1920, printed 'U.': Newry Reporter, 10 June 1920, p. 5 ("Armagh County Council: Markethill Area", with every count)).
